package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_caching_per_request_config_cache_rebuild: Layer: Caching. Flag request-scoped caches rebuilt from config or environment on every call.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
type featureConfig struct {
	Enabled bool
	Limit   int
}

func scenario512Positive() *featureConfig {
	// Re-reads and parses the config file on every call — even when
	// the file has not changed between requests.
	data, _ := os.ReadFile("/etc/app/features.json")
	cfg := &featureConfig{}
	json.Unmarshal(data, cfg)
	return cfg
}
